graph.stats.ours_help: A device is one of ours when we can put a callsign to it: heard as an XPRS packet, or announced with a key that produces the name. A node running this software that never says who it is cannot be addressed, so it is counted here and shown nowhere.
graph.stats.others_help: Other people's devices — NomadNet, Sideband, anything else on Reticulum. Counted from the on-disk cache, so the totals persist across restarts; the live graph is a sampled view, not a hub's full roster.
graph.passive.help: Stay meshed and carry your own traffic, but stop doing relay work for others (sheds CPU).
